mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supplier_reconciliation_cases (id, tenant_id, application_id, discrepancy_type, details, status, detected_at, resolved_at) VALUES (#{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{tenantId}, #{applicationId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{discrepancyType}, CAST(#{details} AS jsonb), 'OPEN', #{detectedAt}, NULL) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, application_id, discrepancy_type) DO UPDATE SET details = EXCLUDED.details, status = 'OPEN', detected_at = EXCLUDED.detected_at, resolved_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier_reconciliation_cases SET status = 'RESOLVED', resolved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND application_id = #{applicationId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND status = 'OPEN'
